Definition: from G4002 and G1540; five hundred:--five hundred.
BiblicalUsage: Pentakosioi means five hundred. Paul says the risen Christ was seen by above five hundred brethren at once, and Jesus told of a creditor with two debtors, one owing five hundred pence and the other fifty.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that five hundred witnesses cannot be wished away: the resurrection was seen by a crowd, and the debt was forgiven by grace.
